New Shingle Roof Installation in Oakland | ROOF EXPRESS
Expert Asphalt Shingle Roofing Services in Oakland, CA
If you're considering a new shingle roof installation in Oakland, choosing the right contractor is critical. At ROOF EXPRESS, we specialize in high-quality asphalt shingle roofing systems designed to withstand Oakland’s unique microclimate—ranging from coastal moisture to inland heat.

As a Diamond Certified roofing company and GAF Certified Installer, we deliver durable, energy-efficient roofing solutions for both residential and light commercial properties.
Why Homeowners in Oakland Choose Shingle Roofing
Asphalt shingles remain the most popular roofing material in Oakland—and for good reason:

Cost-effective compared to tile or metal roofing

Versatile designs to match modern and traditional homes

Durable performance against wind, UV exposure, and rain

Quick installation timelines

Easy maintenance and repairs

With proper installation, a shingle roof can last 20–30+ years, especially when installed by certified professionals like ROOF EXPRESS.
Our Shingle Roof Installation Process
At ROOF EXPRESS, we follow a proven step-by-step installation system to ensure long-term performance and code compliance:
1. Roof Inspection & Estimate
We begin with a detailed inspection of your existing roof structure, decking, and ventilation system.
2. Tear-Off & Preparation
Old roofing materials are safely removed. We inspect and replace damaged plywood or sheathing if needed.
3. Underlayment & Waterproofing
We install high-quality synthetic underlayment and ice/water shield in vulnerable areas to protect against leaks.
4. Shingle Installation
We install premium architectural shingles from brands like GAF and CertainTeed, ensuring proper alignment, nailing patterns, and ventilation.
5. Final Inspection & Cleanup
Our team performs a full quality check and leaves your property clean and protected.
Best Shingles for Oakland’s Climate
Oakland’s weather varies by neighborhood, so selecting the right shingle matters. We recommend:

Architectural (Dimensional) Shingles – Best balance of durability and aesthetics

Cool Roof Shingles – Reflect heat, ideal for energy efficiency

High-Wind Rated Shingles – Great for exposed hillside areas

Our team helps you choose the best system based on your home’s location, slope, and sun exposure.
Signs You Need a New Shingle Roof
Not sure if it's time for replacement? Look for these warning signs:

Missing, cracked, or curling shingles

Frequent roof leaks or water stains

Roof age over 20 years

Granule loss in gutters

Sagging roof areas

If you notice any of these, it's time to schedule a professional inspection.
Why Choose ROOF EXPRESS in Oakland
Homeowners across Oakland trust ROOF EXPRESS because we provide:

Diamond Certified quality and customer satisfaction

GAF Certified installation standards

Transparent pricing with detailed estimates

Fast project timelines and clean job sites

Strong local reputation in the Bay Area

We don’t just install roofs—we build long-term protection for your home.
